name: Ranch Smothered Pork Chops Skillet
ingredients: 1 oz. packet Ranch seasoning mix (about 3 tablespoons)
why: Verified 438 cal / 14g carbs / 35g protein per serving - dead center of the band with room to spare on carbs. Distinct ranch-and-mushroom cream angle, not a dupe of the creamy-garlic/parmesan/tuscan/french-onion pork chops already in the pool. Pure skillet smother, scales cleanly to 14 with weigh-and-divide. All ingredients map to the board (cream-of-mushroom-soup, ranch-seasoning-mix, sour-cream all tracked).
